house.description: Minnesota Age in Place Network funding provided, and money appropriated.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Human Services Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for the Minnesota Age in Place Network.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; AGE WELL AT HOME. +]

[+$3,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Age Well at Home to establish the Minnesota Age in Place Network. Eligible uses of grant money are providing home modifications and safety renovations at the owner-occupied homes of older low- to moderate-income homeowners. No single modification or renovation project may exceed $20,000. Age Well at Home may also use up to ten percent of the grant money for administrative expenses attributable to establishing, expanding, and maintaining the Minnesota Age in Place Network. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; appropriating money for the Minnesota Age in Place Network.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; AGE WELL AT HOME.

$3,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for a grant to Age Well at Home to establish the Minnesota Age in Place Network. Eligible uses of grant money are providing home modifications and safety renovations at the owner-occupied homes of older low- to moderate-income homeowners. No single modification or renovation project may exceed $20,000. Age Well at Home may also use up to ten percent of the grant money for administrative expenses attributable to establishing, expanding, and maintaining the Minnesota Age in Place Network.

Age Well at Home may also use up to ten percent of the grant money for administrative expenses attributable to establishing, expanding, and maintaining the Minnesota Age in Place Network.
